text:
maria: quick design review request — pushed a fresh figma for the usage dashboard iteration: https://www.figma.com/file/XXX. Main asks: 1) visual hierarchy between expense meter and trend chart, 2) token breakdown per-model vs aggregate, 3) invoice download location, 4) org vs project context UX. need feedback by EOD friday :eyes:

alex: skimmed — main instinct: the big circular meter is attention-grabbing but pulls focus away from the token table. can we reduce its visual weight and make the time-series the primary focus? also suggest collapsing low-volume models into “other” to reduce noise.

jordan: a couple of data questions before we finalize layout: is the token breakdown coming from near-real-time counters or the daily rollup? live counters add complexity for billing accuracy. can the frontend call /billing/usage?start=...&scope=project to fetch per-model token+cost?

sam: agree with alex on hierarchy. also: org vs project switch is ambiguous when users have multiple nested projects. prefer a persistent context pill (top-left) that shows current scope and a crumb to switch back. invoices must be scoped to context — clicking "download invoice" while in project view should default to project invoice, not org.

lee: a11y nits: color contrast on the meter gradients is low for colorblind users, focus order currently: toggle -> meter -> chart -> token table. keyboard users expect filters -> chart -> table. ARIA labels needed for the org/project toggle, and the chart needs descriptive alt text. also tooltip copy should be programmatic (no punctuation only short phrases).

alex: microcopy: change "Estimated charges" to "Estimated charges (USD)" when we show currency, and add a small ? tooltip explaining that estimates exclude pending credits. CTA on invoices: use "Download PDF" not "Export".

jordan: backend note: if we collapse models into "other", we should surface the top 5 by spend and allow expanding the bucket. that keeps the token table compact but drillable. also API will return both "realtime" and "finalized" metrics; recommend UI default to finalized for billing panes and realtime for live monitoring panes.

deploy-bot: design-preview deployed to staging: https://staging.redwood.ai/design-previews/usage-v3 — commit 4f9e2b. screenshots attached in the staging page.

maria: thanks all — plan below and owners: 1) reduce meter prominence + promote time-series: @alex (design) — due Wed 10am. 2) collapse-to-other with expand behavior + API contract: @jordan (eng) + @alex — jordan to return {"top_models":[], "other_total": "..."}. 3) org/project context pill + persistence + permissions check: @sam — confirm expected permission rules. 4) accessibility fixes: @lee — contrast, focus order, ARIA labels. 5) invoice CTA copy + tooltip text: @alex. i’ll update figma and add notes.

sam: sounds good. can we add a visual QA checklist (keyboard nav, zoom 200%, NVDA pass) for the release? i can own QA once the staging build is up. :+1:

maria: yes — i'll add QA checklist to the staging page and tag everyone. thanks — will loop back with updated mocks by Wed.
